[{"insert":"Strict Pull Up

Your pulling strength runs as a mechanical drop set this cycle, so you keep training the back after your hardest position gives out. Start with pronated strict pull ups at a 21X1 tempo, using only as much assistance as you need to hit the reps clean, then move straight into the DB gorilla row to keep loading once the overhand grip is spent. Reps on the pull up drop to six this week, the lowest of the block, so this is your heaviest and most honest pulling. Stay strict with no kip and squeeze your shoulder blades down and back on every rep.
"}]
